Bahrain Public Holidays and Holiday Work Pay

The next holiday is shown first; then calculate what you are owed if you work on a holiday.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Pay for working on a public holiday

Public holidays in Bahrain: 2026 and 2027

Pay for working on a holiday

A worker who works on a public holiday is entitled to the day's wage plus extra pay equal to 150% of it, or another day off instead, at the worker's choice (Article 64). We calculate the day's wage as salary ÷ 30 and the amount owed as 2.5 times that on top of salary. On another reading the day's wage is already in the salary, so the extra is 1.5 times.

Example: salary BHD 600 and one working day on Eid: 600 ÷ 30 = 20, so you are owed BHD 50 or a day off. On the other reading, BHD 30.

Holidays that fall on a Friday

If a holiday falls on a Friday or another public holiday, the worker gets another day instead (Article 2 of Decision 1/2013). In 2027, New Year's Day (Friday 1 January) and National Day (Friday 17 December) are compensated, and Eid al-Fitr may be if it ends on a Friday.

Government sector

The government follows circulars from the Crown Prince and Prime Minister for each occasion, including Arafat Day and days in lieu. The private sector follows Decision 1/2013, which does not include Arafat Day.

Hijri dates are expected and may move by a day depending on the moon sighting.

Frequently asked questions

How many public holidays does the private sector get in Bahrain?

14 days: the Islamic New Year, Tasu'a and Ashura, the Prophet's Birthday, Eid al-Fitr (3 days), Eid al-Adha (3 days), New Year's Day, Labour Day, and National Day and Accession Day (2 days) under Cabinet Decision 1/2013. The decision does not include Arafat Day, which the government grants by circular.

How much is pay for working on a public holiday in Bahrain?

The day's wage plus extra pay equal to 150% of it, or another day off instead, at the worker's choice (Article 64). Example: salary BHD 600: 20 × 2.5 = BHD 50 on top of salary.

What if a holiday falls on a Friday?

The worker gets another day instead (Article 64 and Decision 1/2013), as when it falls on another holiday. Saturday is not mentioned, so Labour Day on Saturday 1 May 2027 has no day in lieu on our reading.

When is Bahrain National Day in 2026?

Wednesday 16 and Thursday 17 December 2026; in 2027 it falls on Thursday and Friday 16–17 December, with a day in lieu for the Friday.
